purpose: Play retained paper, electrical and extinguisher flipbooks and share procedural smoke and surface-stamp shaders.
state_owner: Atlas layouts (grid, frame count, frame timing) of supplied effect sprite sheets

sprite_flipbook_v1.spawn: spawn(parent: Node, atlas: Dictionary, position: Vector3, size: float, options := {}) -> MeshInstance3D; null when the atlas texture is missing. The node frees itself after the last frame.
sprite_flipbook_v1.frame_at: frame_at(atlas: Dictionary, seconds: float) -> float; fractional frame for a play time, -1 after the end
sprite_flipbook_v1.options: additive option keys (missing = previous behaviour): cycle (repeat the whole sheet in order until stop()), ground (flat on the floor, top away from the camera, stretched by the atlas ground_stretch)

effect_atlases_v1.atlas: Retained electrical spark, torn paper and extinguisher Dictionaries. Skill and grenade explosion constants retired by owner request (ADR-0059).
effect_atlases_v1.size_for_radius: size_for_radius(atlas: Dictionary, radius: float) -> float; quad size whose drawn ring/spread (atlas extent) covers the radius

surface_atlases_v1.material: material(texture: Texture2D, cell: int) -> ShaderMaterial; immutable BULLET/GLASS textures, row-major 4x2, bullet 0..4, scorch 5..7, glass 0..7; per-mark material

runtime_contracts.surface_stamp_v1: build(receiver: MeshInstance3D, projector: Transform3D, size: Vector2, depth: float, skip_glass = false) -> ArrayMesh; immutable receiver, clipped real triangles, continuous projector UV, null if no receiving faces
runtime_contracts.blood_level_v1: BloodLevel (static): set_level(value: int) clamps to 0..COUNT-1 (0 green, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 maximum); color() -> Color for droplets and procedural decals; scale_amount(amount: int) -> int; scale_speed(speed: float) -> float. Set from Video settings only.
runtime_contracts.surface_stamp_cache_v1: Owned RefCounted instance: build(receiver, projector, size, depth, skip_glass = false) -> ArrayMesh; same geometry as surface_stamp_v1; bounded 128 immutable Mesh snapshots/indices; Mesh.changed invalidation; destroying owner disconnects observers. Caller owns cache and output.
